fib: ______ is the rule of might by a certain individuals of the armed forces usurping political powers and suspending the Constitution.

______ is used to explain what was said by legislature, not to change it as at the time of Heydon's case.
mischief rule

______ is the rule of the law, not the rule of might.
Rule of law
Rule of law is the rule of the law, not the rule of might.

ouster clause
